description: A lab-local JWT weakness: the lab API accepts tokens signed with the none algorithm and tokens signed with the public key as an HMAC secret, so anyone can forge an admin token.

evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; forged token uses alg none with role admin, and the API returned 200 with admin data
evidence.response: 200 OK, admin data returned for the forged token

impact: An attacker could forge any lab role, including admin, without knowing a secret.
proof_of_concept: Send a JWT with alg none and role admin to /lab/api/admin; the API returns admin data without verifying a signature.
remediation: Reject alg none, verify signatures with the correct algorithm and key, and never accept a public key as an HMAC secret.
steps_to_reproduce: Craft a JWT with alg none and role admin
Send it as a Bearer token to /lab/api/admin
Observe admin data returned without signature verification
title: JWT signature verification bypass in lab API
